mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns: lower rates predict positive returns due to reduced discount rates on equity cash flows. This relationship holds continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows < 0.03, or positive returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals imminent Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days due to heightened risk aversion and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0%) and industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced earnings and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% with 3-month rise > 0.2%) cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to reduced liquidity and increased cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) level positively correlates with S&P 500 20-day forward returns: higher starts signal robust consumer spending and growth, supporting equity valuations without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows < 0.03, or positive returns in < 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 95 (INDPRO < 95) signals imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days due to reduced corporate earnings and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals labor market overheating, triggering Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced liquidity and increased risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 105% of 1-year moving average signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to sustained economic growth and equity support.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when RSAFS > 105% of 1-year MA, or Rank IC < 0.03.
